roster.name: MIRAGE (Minimum Information Required About a Glycomics Experiment)
roster.description: An umbrella reporting-guidelines framework for glycomics experiments designed to define minimum information for describing glycomics data and workflows (aims, guideline builder, recommendations, meetings and publications). It sets the overall goals and provides links to specific MIRAGE guideline documents and exemplar reporting practices.

roster.name: MIRAGE Sample Preparation Guidelines
roster.description: Reporting guideline for sample generation, purification and modification in glycomics (sample origin, isolation, enzymatic/chemical treatment, modification, purification steps and defined sample naming). Versioned PDF (v1.0) with published DOI.

roster.name: MIRAGE Mass Spectrometric Analysis Guidelines
roster.description: MS reporting guideline for mass spectrometric analysis of glycans and glycoproteins (requirements for reporting MS experiments and derived data), published in Mol. Cell. Proteomics (versioned document with DOI).

roster.name: MIRAGE Glycan Microarray Analysis Guidelines
roster.description: Guidelines for reporting glycan microarray experiments (experimental setup, data capture and reporting expectations for glycan-binding assays on microarrays).

roster.name: MIRAGE Liquid Chromatography Analysis Guidelines
roster.description: Reporting guideline for liquid chromatography analyses in glycomics (metadata and reporting requirements for LC methods applied to glycans).

roster.name: MIRAGE NMR Glycan Recognition Guidelines
roster.description: Guidelines focused on NMR experiments used to study glycan–protein recognition (reporting of experimental conditions, parameters and interpretation; noted as manuscript in preparation on the seed page).

roster.name: MIRAGE NMR Glycan Structures Guidelines
roster.description: Guidelines for reporting NMR-derived glycan structural data (what to report for structural NMR experiments on glycans; listed on site as a guideline document).

roster.name: MIRAGE Capillary Electrophoresis Analysis Guidelines
roster.description: Reporting standard for capillary electrophoresis analyses of glycans (metadata/experimental reporting for CE methods; includes publication details and versioning).

roster.name: MIRAGE Lectin Microarray Analysis Guidelines
roster.description: Guidelines for reporting lectin microarray experiments (experimental design, data capture and reporting for lectin-based glycan-binding assays).
